easy.def: The lightest gas in the world.

more.def: A very light gas that has no color or smell; two parts of it join with oxygen to make water.
examples: Hydrogen is the lightest gas, so a balloon filled with it floats high.
Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen.
The sun is made mostly of hydrogen.

easy.def: A wild animal like a dog that makes a laughing sound.

more.def: A wild African animal that looks like a dog, has strong jaws and makes a loud, laughing sound.
examples: The hyena let out a laughing call in the dark.
A hyena has powerful jaws that can crush bones.
Hyenas live in groups called clans on the African plains.

easy.def: A slow, holy song sung in church.

more.def: A song of praise, usually sung in a church or at a religious service.
examples: The choir sang a hymn in the church on Sunday morning.
Everyone stood up to sing the hymn together.
She learned the words to an old hymn from her grandmother.

more.def: So funny that you cannot stop laughing, or wildly upset and out of control.
examples: The clown was hysterical, and we laughed until we cried.
Her costume was hysterical, and the whole class laughed.
